name: Inkling Small
title: Inkling Small: price, context window and specs
answer: Inkling Small is a model in Thinking Machines's Thinking Machines Inkling family, first listed on 2026-07-30. It takes text, image and audio in and returns text, with a context window of 524K tokens and up to 262K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.45 per million input tokens and $1.2 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
compare: It is the newest of the 2 versions of Thinking Machines Inkling listed today.
Its input price is below the family median of $1 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
